## Changes

- `nitpicker cache publish` refuses options it does not take, such as `--rule` and `--defer-exit`, which it used to ignore. Drop them from your `cache publish` step.
- The default ESLint engine (oxlint) no longer fails with "oxlint planning exited with 2" when nitpicker is installed under a `node_modules` folder that `.gitignore` lists.
- The TypeScript and JavaScript presets report regular expressions in production code with a part that never changes what they match or does not do what it looks like (an assertion that always accepts or rejects, a duplicate alternative or class member, an empty group, a backreference that is always empty) and forms with a shorter equivalent (`a{1}`, `(?:ab)c`, `[a]`), through 34 more `eslint-plugin-regexp` rules. A new or edited line with such a pattern fails the gate.
